responsibility: Provides the core target macro configuration for the V850 port. It defines default CPU selection and command specs, preprocessor builtins, ABI-visible target properties such as endianness, word and pointer modes, debugging and unwind settings, jump-table and alignment policies, Green Hills pragma registration, section-kind and small-data metadata, symbol flags for ZDA/TDA/SDA addressing, and other target macros that parameterize generic GCC code and the V850 backend implementation.
same_name_distinction: The target configuration header for the V850 port: unlike v850.cc's compiled hook implementations, v850.md's instruction-pattern machine description, or v850.opt's command-line option table, this file provides preprocessor macros, ABI/layout constants, assembler/linker specs, section-kind declarations, and shared declarations that parameterize the rest of the backend.
